Lu-dovici Capelli Critica Sacra materiem disputationibus his diebus suppeditavit propter SacriConcilii Tridenti[illegible, ~2 letters]de vul-gata Bibliæ editione decretum, & contra malos interpretes & contra illos, qui sibi facultatem arrogant libros sacros pro-prio Marte emendandi & edendi; adver-sam vero sententiam non tantumCriticæ Auctor affirmat & docet, sed ex pluri-bus ejus dictis induci asserunt, illud ab eo privatæ auctoritati tribui, quod Ec-clesiæ, & summo Pontifici reservatum videtur, etiamsi in minima dictione auc[?] vocula correctio esset adhibenda: præser-tim post editionem á Clemente VIII, factam summo cum plausu&unanimita-te Ecclesiæ Catholicæ receptam; quam opinionem sequitur inter cæteros Auctò-[?]res magnæ notæ Melchior Canus, qui in suo locorum Theologicorum opere, quam

page.notes: The ink blot over "Tridenti" in line 8 hides about two letters (the "ni" of Tridentini); marked as illegible. The "&" before "contra" in line 9 sits near the blot but is readable. The word "auc" at the end of line 18 is the printed form and is doubtful; the hyphenation of "Auctò-res" at the end of line 22 is also doubtful. The page number "595" at top right is partly blurred at the last digit. A small stray stroke at top left and faint digitiser text at bottom right are not printed text and are left out.
